finalText:
Perfect! All tests are now passing. The issue was that the pagination function was treating page numbers as if they were 0-indexed when they're actually 1-indexed.

**The fix:** Changed `const start = page * perPage;` to `const start = (page - 1) * perPage;`

This ensures:
- Page 1 starts at index 0 (first 3 items)
- Page 2 starts at index 3 (next 3 items)
- Page 4 starts at index 9 (last item)

All 5 tests are green ✓
